2608.25536.title: Syn2Logic: End-to-End Neuromorphic Design Automation
2608.25536.paper_summary: In this work, we propose a view on electronic Neuromorphic Design Automation (eNDA), which we see as a design automation flow that bridges computational neuroscience modeling with traditional Electronic Design Automation (EDA) flow. We introduce the term, give examples of how it can be implemented, and design a prototype implementation: Syn2Logic. Syn2Logic is an entire eNDA framework, that allows neuroscientists to model neural behavior using a custom DSL and a compiler that takes the same model description down to synthesizable RTL hardware. We end the paper by applying the eNDA-flow through Syn2Logic to show how to -- without writing a single line of hardware description language (HDL) code-- (i) generate what we believe is the fastest C. elegans accelerator that runs significantly faster than state-of-the-art simulators, (ii) create (to the best of our knowledge) the fastest, most generic neuromorphic sudoku solver that outperforms CP-SAT and SCIP on TOP1465 puzzles, and (iii) create a 5.6 million FPS/Watt accelerator on a tiny FPGA that outperforms existing neuromorphic architectures in terms of speed and energy-efficiency on the MNIST dataset.
2608.25536.paper_summary_zh: 在這項工作中，我們提出了一種電子類神經形態設計自動化（eNDA）的觀點，我們將其視為一種設計自動化流程，該流程將計算神經科學建模與傳統電子設計自動化（EDA）流程相連接。<lb/>我們引入了這個術語，並給出了如何實施的例子，還設計了一個原型實現：Syn2Logic。<lb/>Syn2Logic是一個完整的eNDA框架，允許神經科學家使用自定義DSL和一個將相同模型描述轉換為可合成RTL硬體的編譯器來建模神經行為。<lb/>我們在論文的最後應用eNDA流程通過Syn2Logic來展示如何在不編寫任何硬體描述語言（HDL）代碼的情況下-- (i) 生成我們認為是最快的C. elegans加速器，其運行速度顯著快於最先進的模擬器，(ii) 創建（據我們所知）最快、最通用的類神經形態數獨解決器，在TOP1465謎題上超越CP-SAT和SCIP，(iii) 在一個微小的FPGA上創建一個每瓦5.6百萬幀的加速器，在速度和能效方面超越現有的類神經形態架構，特別是在MNIST數據集上。
